$comment: Copy to config/ideno.config.json and adapt. That file is gitignored.
Secrets: prefer api_key_env (read from the environment) over api_key in the file.
The browser NEVER receives provider configuration — only a redacted view (provider ids, models, origins).
Privacy modes: LOCAL_ONLY (never send data to cloud providers), PREFERRED_LOCAL (try local first), CLOUD_ALLOWED (routing order as configured), CLOUD_ONLY (local providers excluded).
structured_output: 'json_schema' (native structured outputs), 'json_object' (valid JSON but schema enforced only by Ideno), 'none' (prompt-based; Ideno validates and repairs once).

Routing (§11): each task names a primary provider plus fallbacks; fallbacks are filtered by the privacy mode — LOCAL_ONLY will never fall back to a cloud provider. v0.1 has one task ('conversation'); the table exists so per-task model selection can be added without touching the core.
Verify a provider before first use: export its api_key env var, then run 'npm run provider:check <provider-id>'.

local-ollama.$note: Ollama serves an OpenAI-compatible API; no key needed. For older builds that reject json_schema, set structured_output to json_object or none.

local-vllm.$note: vLLM supports guided structured output and stream usage. 'local' here means user-controlled infrastructure — it does NOT have to be localhost.

remote-selfhosted.$note: A remote endpoint you control. Declared privacy 'cloud' because data leaves your machine — privacy declarations must be honest, not aspirational.

cloud-openai.$note: Requests go browser → Ideno backend → provider. The key never reaches the browser.

gateway.$note: Aggregators/gateways (OpenRouter-style) work like any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

nvidia-nim.$note: NVIDIA NIM's hosted API is OpenAI-compatible (chat/completions, Bearer nvapi-... keys, model ids like 'meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct' — use the exact id from build.nvidia.com). Run 'npm run provider:check nvidia-nim' with NVIDIA_API_KEY set to verify before starting the app. structured_output support varies by model: if the endpoint rejects response_format json_schema, set it to 'json_object' or 'none' — Ideno then validates the output itself and repairs once if needed.

demo.$note: DETERMINISTIC SCRIPTED PROVIDER — NOT AN AI MODEL. Ships as the safe default so a fresh clone boots and the state pipeline can be demonstrated without any model. Clearly labeled as a demo in the UI. Replace it with a real provider for actual idea development.

context.$note: How many recent conversation messages are sent as supporting context. The Idea State itself is always sent (it is canonical); the conversation is not.
